Hello! I am an infectious disease epidemiologist and modeller. My research focuses on developing and applying statistical and mathematical models to understand infectious disease dynamics and inform public health policy. I have worked on malaria, dengue, COVID-19, and diphtheria.

I am currently a Research Fellow at [Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health, National University of Singapore](https://sph.nus.edu.sg/), [MLGH-SG](https://mlgh-sg.com/) group.

:::

## Research Interests

- Infectious disease epidemiology and modelling
- Statistical and mathematical models for public health
- Real-time outbreak analysis
- Intervention scenarios and evaluations
- Capacity building on infectious disease modelling

- Co-founder, [Indonesia Infectious Disease Modelling Community (INDEMIC)](https://www.indemic.id/)
- Member, [MIDSEA](https://midsea.network/)
- Guest editor, [Advancing Infectious Disease Modelling to Inform Health Decision-Making in low- and middle-income countries](https://www.keaipublishing.com/en/journals/infectious-disease-modelling/call-for-papers/advancing-infectious-disease-modelling-to-inform-health-decision-making-in-low-and-middle-income-countries/)

I am always open for collaborations and discussions about infectious disease modelling and infectious diseases research, especially in the Indonesian context. Feel free to reach out at [bimandra.djaafara@nus.edu.sg](mailto:bimandra.djaafara@nus.edu.sg).
